name: Tadotsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tadotsu town emblem in red: a stylised angular device of a lozenge above a chevron.
history: Municipal flag of Tadotsu, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in April 1950.

features.role: Tadotsu town emblem — a stylised angular device of a lozenge above a chevron
